device.name: Meta-World assembly through the metaworld2gym wrapper (simulated)

facts.text: The repository contains a gym wrapper and an automatic demonstration-collection script for Meta-World
The README creates an environment with metaworld2gym.make("door-open"), calls reset() and step(), and unpacks the step result as next_obs, reward, done, info
The default observation dictionary is image (3, 224, 224), depth (224, 224), point_cloud (1024, 6), agent_pos (9,) and full_state (39,)
MetaWorldEnv defaults observation_meta to image, depth, agent_pos, point_cloud and full_state
MetaWorldEnv appends -v2-goal-observable to a task name and builds that class from metaworld.envs.ALL_V2_ENVIRONMENTS_GOAL_OBSERVABLE
MetaWorldEnv sets the episode length to 200 steps and takes its action_space from the wrapped Meta-World environment
MetaWorldEnv.step returns (observation dictionary, reward, done, info) and forces done at the 200-step episode length
MetaWorldEnv.reset resets the wrapped environment and returns the observation dictionary
The wrapped Meta-World environment's action space is a four-element Box from -1 to +1
SawyerXYZEnv.step applies the first three action elements through set_xyz_action and the last element through do_simulation
SawyerXYZEnv defaults frame_skip to 5 and action_scale to 1/100
The MJCF basic scene sets the physics timestep to 0.0025 s
The base environment's dt is model.opt.timestep multiplied by frame_skip
The package requires gym>=0.15.4, mujoco-py>=2.0,<2.2, numpy>=1.18, torch, termcolor, zarr and numba

determinism.notes: MetaWorldEnv.reset takes no seed argument and calls the wrapped environment's reset (metaworld2gym/metaworld_env.py:302-308); the wrapped v2 environment samples its reset vector from numpy's generator, so the seed of cap.world.reset/cap.world.seed is recorded by the bridge but cannot reseed the upstream environment.  The fake uses a fixed placeholder start state and repeats exactly, but it does not share a random stream with upstream.

gaps: the package serves an F0 kinematic stand-in, not the MuJoCo scene: contacts, rigid-body dynamics, the gripper, object motion and the reward of the assembly task are not modelled; the upstream MuJoCo stack was never installed or run, so no trajectory was compared with it

the fake keeps the wrapper's default observation keys but returns smaller placeholder arrays: image 3x8x8, depth 8x8 and point_cloud 16x6, where the configured device renders 3x224x224, 224x224 and 1024x6 (README.md:39-43); agent_pos stays 9 and full_state stays 39
there is no rendering, camera, depth sensor or point-cloud generator in the fake; the image, depth and point-cloud values are test data
the seed of cap.world.reset/cap.world.seed does not reach the wrapped environment: MetaWorldEnv.reset takes no seed (metaworld2gym/metaworld_env.py:302-308), so determinism.seed_control is 'none'
the wrapper's step returns a four-tuple and forces done at 200 steps (metaworld2gym/metaworld_env.py:207, :299); the bridge reports that done flag as terminated, not truncated

timestep_ms is the MJCF physics step of 2.5 ms (metaworld/envs/assets_v2/scene/basic_scene.xml:2); one cap.world.step.v1 tick is one wrapper step and advances frame_skip=5 physics frames, a 12.5 ms control period (metaworld/envs/mujoco/sawyer_xyz/sawyer_xyz_env.py:93-98)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, only commands advance simulated time
snapshot_restore is false: the wrapper exposes no get_state/set_state pair (the wrapped environment has get_env_state/set_env_state, which the Gymnasium bridge does not snapshot)
no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation stays readable
